title:
The {@link UiSdlEpicSetDefaultChartTime} epic sets the default values of `startDate`, `endDate` and `interval`
in filter panel component that triggers the epic

Currently the epic is triggered by:
- `Reliability.ScatterPlotFilterPanel.json`, and
- `Reliability.Reliability.AnalysisFilterPanel.json`

Expected Payload:
- componentId: the {@link UiSdlFilterPanel} whose `dateRange` and `interval` values need to be set to default
name: UiSdlEpicSetDefaultChartTime
